acceptance_checks: LMB and RMB begin pickup on button press without pointer motion.
RMB pickup works while LMB is already held.
Carry preview starts at the source cell and preserves the local grab offset.
The pickup button release does not place the item.
Target highlighting is disabled while pickup button is held and enabled after release.
Carry preview hides the item name but shows the remaining quantity over the icon.
LMB on a free container background drops the complete carried stack and clears the cursor preview.
RMB on a free container background drops exactly one carried unit and keeps the remainder attached to the pointer.
Partial world drop updates the carry quantity and restores the preview position at the pointer.
Global input recognizes free panel background through nested controls without intercepting real inventory cells.
Hover caption describes only an item already present under the pointer, including while carrying.
Hover caption is a compact floating name plate no wider than 260 px.
Hover caption is positioned below the hovered slot without covering it and stays within inventory bounds.
